item.title: Beginner Walking Plan: 4 Weeks From 10 Minutes to 30 Minutes
item.description: A beginner walking plan that builds from 10 minute walks to about 30 minutes in four weeks. Includes a simple weekly table, a talk test for pace and tips for days you miss. Easy to follow and kind to beginners. Guide contains affiliate links.
